response.sql: SELECT f.zoneref AS site_code, s.entrystat AS access_status, AVG(f.traitcount) AS avg_traitcount, COUNT(*) AS record_count, COUNT(*)::numeric / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS record_fraction FROM scanfeatures AS f INNER JOIN sites AS s ON f.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE f.traitcount > 489 GROUP BY f.zoneref, s.entrystat ORDER BY record_fraction DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
